description: The 'dss_webapps_live' dataset provides comprehensive information about live web applications, primarily used for tracking and managing these applications within a project environment. Each entry in the dataset represents a unique web application, identified by a 'webapp_id', and includes details such as the application's name, type, and associated project key. The dataset is particularly useful for developers and project managers who need to monitor the status of web applications, as it includes columns indicating whether the backend is running and if the application is code-based. Additionally, it tracks the creation and last modification timestamps, along with the user details responsible for these actions, which aids in auditing and accountability. The dataset also includes a URL for direct access to each web application, facilitating easy navigation. Tags are provided for categorization, allowing for better organization and retrieval of applications based on specific criteria. Overall, this dataset serves as a vital tool for managing the lifecycle and operational status of web applications in a structured and efficient manner.
shortDesc: Dataset of live web applications with identifiers, types, and status.

columns.name: webapp_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each web application. Key for tracking.

columns.name: webapp_name
columns.comment: Descriptive name of the web application. Identifies purpose.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Identifier for the associated project. Links app to project.

columns.name: webapp_type
columns.comment: Type or category of the web application. Defines function.

columns.name: backend_running
columns.comment: Indicates if the backend is currently running. Status check.

columns.name: created_by_user
columns.comment: Email of the user who created the app. Creator identity.

columns.name: last_modified_user
columns.comment: Email of the user who last modified the app. Modifier identity.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp when the app was created. Tracks creation date.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp of the last modification. Tracks update date.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: JSON array of tags for categorization. Organizes apps.

columns.name: is_code_webapp
columns.comment: Indicates if the app is code-based. Differentiates app type.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for accessing the web application. Direct access link.
